best_lineage.idea: Replace the generic recursive merge sort with an optimized LSD Radix Sort using a static scratch buffer. This eliminates the per-call memory allocation overhead (vector constructor/destructor) and provides linear-time complexity for integer keys, which significantly improves throughput on uniform and duplicate distributions while maintaining stability.
